questions.question: Why are large language models often described as 'black boxes'?
options: Because they can never be used online
Because they generate unpredictable new text from many learned parameters

questions.question: What makes LLM observability necessary in a live AI application?
options: It increases the size of the training dataset
It helps track what the AI is saying and catch problems quickly
It replaces the need for a vector database
It turns the model into a chatbot

questions.question: In the car analogy, LLM observability is compared to:
Which of the following is one of the three main things monitored by an observability dashboard?
options: Word count, font size, and color
Prompt length, user age, and browser type

questions.question: What does latency measure in an LLM system?
options: How long the model takes to answer
How many tokens are in the dataset

questions.question: What does TTFT stand for?
Why is a TTFT of more than 3 seconds a problem for many Gen Z users according to the chapter?
options: They will likely close the app if the first word appears too slowly
They stop using the internet completely

questions.question: What does token cost represent in LLM observability?
options: The number of training layers used
The money spent for tokens the AI reads and writes
The size of the chatbot window
The number of words in the response

questions.question: Why is token cost called the 'fuel gauge' of an AI system?
options: Because it shows how much money the system is consuming
Because it predicts the next token

questions.question: What does drift mean in the context of LLM observability?
options: The AI becomes faster over time
The model's behavior changes away from its original training

questions.question: What is the purpose of LLM-as-a-Judge?
options: To train the model from scratch
To grade AI-generated text using another strong AI
To remove the need for observability

questions.question: Why is LLM-as-a-Judge considered a smart solution for evaluating text?
options: Because it uses strict word matching only
Because it can understand deeper context and judge human-like responses

questions.question: In the MUN analogy, what represents the junior delegates?
options: The custom AI app being evaluated

questions.question: In the MUN analogy, what represents the Executive Board or Senior Chairs?
What does the judge LLM receive in order to evaluate an answer?
options: The prompt, the chatbot's answer, and a strict rubric

questions.question: Which quality might the rubric score in an LLM-as-a-Judge system?
What is the role of the continuous feedback loop in applied AI?
options: To prevent any model updates forever
To make the system smarter over time using observe, evaluate, and fine-tune steps
To store only the first prompt

questions.question: If the observability dashboard flags a conversation with a bad thumbs-down rating, what is the first step in the feedback loop?
If the Judge LLM confirms that the chatbot failed the 'Accuracy' test, what is the next likely step in the loop if the tone was also rude?
options: Add the corrected conversation to a dataset and run SFT
